content:
Nora: Uploaded a fresh mock for the API keys table focused on clarity for rotate/revoke flows. Figma: https://figma.com/file/new-keys
Tai: Nice. Two quick asks: keep interactive row height >=44px and don't remove created/last-used timestamps (auditors need them).
Emil: The inline revoke icon is easy to misclick. Can we move destructive actions into a kebab menu or require a confirm step?
Nora: Agreed. I'll move revoke into kebab and add a lightweight confirm modal. Also adding a details panel for timestamps so table stays compact.
Emil: About undo: backend has an undo endpoint but the feature flag is off in staging. aria-bot, confirm?
aria-bot: Feature flag `revoke_undo` = off in staging; endpoint POST /keys/{id}/undo exists but is gated.
Tai: So copy should be conditional. If flag off, use irreversible language: "This action cannot be undone." If on, show "Undo available for 30s." Also make undo toast keyboard-focusable and announced via aria-live.
Nora: Empty state tweak: Title: "Create an API key" Body: "Start calling Redwood Inference. Use scopes to limit access." Primary CTA: "Create API key" Secondary: "Scopes & best practices" Centered with icon.
Emil: Accessibility checklist for PR: 1) tab order & focus trap, 2) ARIA labels on permission chips, 3) touch targets >=44px, 4) color contrast checks. Add to PR template please.
Nora: Added checklist and will update figma with kebab, confirm modal, details panel, and conditional revoke copy. Will ping when ready for review.
